sentences.text: With the consent, heard finally.
Perused the case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of bail to the applicant, as he has been arrested on 15.06.2023 in connection with Crime No.231/2023 registered at Police Station Bhitarwar, District Gwalior (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 366, 376,
506 and 34 of IPC.
Prosecution case, in brief, is that on 09.03.2023 at about 21:00 hours, when the prosecutrix was all alone in the house, the applicant along with other co-accused person came there in a black colored four wheeler and forcefully got her seated in the car and took her to Golpahariya, Gwalior, where Manoj vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161670833/

sentences.text: they committed rape upon her.
They also threatened to kill her, if she discloses this fact to anybody.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the matter.
He further submits that prosecutrix is a major lady.
FIR was lodged after more than three months without any plausible explanation.
Statement of the prosecutrix recorded during investigation is inconsistent with her own FIR.
Whole prosecution story is doubtful.
The applicant is in custody since 15.06.2023.
Investigation is almost complete.
His custodial interrogation or trial is not required in the matter.
Trial will take time for its conclusion.

Hence,
prayer is made to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as counsel for the complainant opposed the application and submitted that due to threaten given by the applicant, the prosecutrix could not report the matter.
The prosecutrix has specifically made allegations against the applicant.

Therefore,
he be not released on bail.

Having considered the rival submissions, material pointed out by learned counsel for the applicant,
specially the delayed FIR, so also considering the statement of the prosecutrix recorded during investigation and considering the other facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail, hence, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during the pendency of trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C.
This application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per rules.

(SATYENDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE bj/-
